narrative:
## Financial Statements — Plan Submission Summary

3-statement model validated and approved by Pablo Andres, Chief Financial Officer. All versions (FY2025 Actuals, FY2026 Budget, FY2026 Q3 Forecast, FY2024 Actuals) reconciled.

## Key Metrics
• Revenue: GBP 1,803.8M actuals / GBP 1,833.3M budget / GBP 1,812.9M Q3 forecast
• Adjusted EBITDA margin: 9.6% actuals / 9.7% budget
• Free cash flow: GBP 17M actuals / GBP 19M budget
• Balance sheet: assets = liabilities + equity

signals.title: Civil Service Pension Scheme: £25–40m profit hit in 2026
signals.source: Capita trading & CSPS contract update — 9 July 2026
signals.excerpt: Surge resourcing, remediation and KPI-related costs are expected to reduce 2026 adjusted operating profit by £25m–£40m, with a £35m–£50m free cash flow impact.
